problem_status: OPEN (k >= 4). k = 3 is Bloom-Sisask 2020, not formalized in Mathlib.
build_mode: clean_room (build dir deleted, all files recompiled in order)
compile_command: LEAN_PATH=$(cd /root/formalizer/proofs && lake env printenv LEAN_PATH):$BUILD  nice -n 19 taskset -c 0,1 lean -o $BUILD/$f.olean $SRC/$f.lean
sorry_scan: no `sorry`, `admit` or `native_decide` token in any proof; the only string matches are in doc comments
axiom_audit: receipts/axioms.txt — every result depends on exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; no sorryAx

banked_results.name: Erdos3.summable_recip_iff
banked_results.statement: Summable (recip A) <-> Summable (fun j => blockCount A j / 2^j). The reciprocal sum of A converges iff the series of dyadic densities |A cap [2^j,2^(j+1))|/2^j converges.
banked_results.novelty: known folklore; not previously kernel-checked, not in Mathlib or formal-conjectures

banked_results.name: Erdos3.summable_of_log_power_bound
banked_results.statement: If count A N <= C*N/(log N)^(1+eps) for some eps>0 and all N >= N0, then sum_{n in A} 1/n converges.

banked_results.name: Erdos3.divergent_forces_density
banked_results.statement: If sum_{n in A} 1/n diverges then for every eps>0, C>=0 and every N0 there is N >= N0 with count A N > C*N/(log N)^(1+eps).

banked_results.name: Erdos3.erdos3_of_quantSzemeredi
banked_results.statement: QuantSzemeredi k -> for every A with divergent reciprocal sum, A contains a k-term AP. QuantSzemeredi k is r_k(N) << N/(log N)^(1+eps); it is Bloom-Sisask for k=3 and open for k>=4.

banked_results.name: Erdos3.frequently_hasAP_iff_forall
banked_results.statement: (exists-frequently k in atTop, HasAPOfLength A k) <-> (forall k, HasAPOfLength A k). Validates the shape used by the FormalConjectures statement of Erdos 3.

banked_results.name: Erdos3.log_power_threshold_sharp
banked_results.statement: There is A with divergent reciprocal sum whose dyadic densities satisfy blockCount A j / 2^j <= 1/(j+1).

banked_results.name: Erdos3.count_critical_le
banked_results.statement: count critical N <= 1 + 4*log 2*N/log N for all N >= 4, where `critical` keeps the first floor(2^j/(j+1)) integers of each dyadic block.

banked_results.name: Erdos3.log_threshold_sharp_counting
banked_results.statement: There is A and C >= 0 with count A N <= 1 + C*N/log N for all N >= 4 and yet sum_{n in A} 1/n diverges. Hence the exponent 1+eps in summable_of_log_power_bound cannot be lowered to 1.

not_proved: Erdos Problem 3 itself, for any k >= 3.
QuantSzemeredi k for any k >= 3 (k=3 is Bloom-Sisask 2020, unformalized; k>=4 is open).
The converse direction: that Erdos 3 for length k implies a quantitative Szemeredi bound.
